description: This file defines the implementation of a JavaScript function wrapper within the WebKitBrowser's InjectedBundle component. It includes constructor setup, static method construction, and property attribute configurations for JavaScript functions exposed through the C++ layer.

classes.name: JavaScriptFunction
classes.description: Represents a JavaScript function with a name, callback, and attributes, providing functionality to build static function representations for JavaScript integration.

methods.name: JavaScriptFunction::BuildJSStaticFunction
methods.description: Constructs and returns a JSStaticFunction struct configured with the function's name, callback, and attributes such as read-only, non-deletable, and optionally non-enumerable.
